inspiration.observed_pattern: A grouped LEFT JOIN conditionally counts child events against each of two parent-side participant columns to compute two scores.
inspiration.mysql_mariadb_translation: Minimized to one scored match and one scoreless match, retaining the two conditional aggregates and the zero-preserving LEFT JOIN.

fixture_notes: Match 3151 has one home score; match 3152 has no score events and must remain with two zero totals.
determinism_notes: Match and score-event identifiers and final ordering are fixed; no clocks, randomness, sleeps, or concurrent schedules are used.
setup: CREATE TABLE tournament_matches (match_id INT PRIMARY KEY, match_day DATE NOT NULL, home_team_id INT NOT NULL, away_team_id INT NOT NULL)
CREATE TABLE tournament_scores (score_event_id INT PRIMARY KEY, match_id INT NOT NULL, scoring_team_id INT NOT NULL)

steps.sql: SELECT m.match_id, m.match_day, m.home_team_id, SUM(CASE WHEN s.scoring_team_id = m.home_team_id THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS home_score, m.away_team_id, SUM(CASE WHEN s.scoring_team_id = m.away_team_id THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS away_score FROM tournament_matches AS m LEFT JOIN tournament_scores AS s ON s.match_id = m.match_id GROUP BY m.match_id, m.match_day, m.home_team_id, m.away_team_id ORDER BY m.match_day, m.match_id

checks.sql: SELECT match_id, match_day, home_team_id, away_team_id FROM tournament_matches ORDER BY match_id
SELECT score_event_id, match_id, scoring_team_id FROM tournament_scores ORDER BY score_event_id
